article.headline: Who Owns Weddings.io? Why This Specific Domain Battle Matters
article.description: Industry Army Marketing has owned Weddings.io since 2015. Inside the 150+ domain ecosystem — Videographers.io, Caterers.tv, InsuranceBrokers.io, Brides.ltd, Grooms.ltd, Parents.ltd and more — disrupting corporate wedding platforms with small-business pricing and AI-speed execution.
